source.fragmentationNote: The Flood Story is one of the most fragmentary major Sumerian compositions. ETCSL identifies 5 surviving segments (A-E) separated by 4 large lacunae (~32, 34, 38, 33 lines missing) plus an opening lacuna of ~36 lines before Segment A. Total preserved: 89 lines; total lacuna estimate: ~173 lines (~34% of the composition preserved).
